script_excerpt: 两位夜班同事在雨站候车，货车遮挡后其中一人缺席。
emotion: 普通生活与观众独自感到的不安
scene_facts: 日常对白、货车和雨先成立，不用音乐提前告知异常。

script_excerpt: 她平静地说就我一个。观众记得同伴，城市照常继续，切失帧片名。
emotion: 高级、冷峻、悬疑；不提供恐惧答案
scene_facts: 回答后才进入，片名沿同一actual录音；S01前退尽，终场反转仍留雨声。

musical_design.narrative_function: 让观众独自保留已经被世界忘记的关系，以未完成应答建立城市主题，不解释消失原因
musical_design.style: cold minimalist electronic chamber score, nocturnal urban mystery, precise and spacious
musical_design.instrumentation: dry bass clarinet offers two short descending notes; granular analog synth carries their residue; thin viola harmonics add a cold edge; controlled low register
musical_design.pulse: slow irregular breath-like pulse, elastic rests, no dance groove
musical_design.development: start sparse after the human answer; repeat a small incomplete cell with widening gaps; withhold its expected reply; open decaying tail, no climax
musical_design.mix_intent: deep quiet space, clean transients; leave speech frequencies open; no location sound effects
musical_design.continuity: return to the same audible cell within this recording; select real phrases for opening and later end slate
musical_design.exclusions: humming, whispers, horror stingers, screeching strings, trailer hits, risers, beat drops, pop chorus, thunder
listening_checks: 仅在就我一个的回答余波后进入，观众先读懂空位
两音与缺失应答须从actual source辨认，不能凭Prompt认定实现
不能出现人声或突发惊吓，片名不成为预告片高潮
S01前音乐退尽；片尾延续优先同源区间，结尾反转仍留真实雨声

script_excerpt: 小程服务林序，提醒里面烫并给饭团垫纸。
scene_facts: 完整复用获认可的S01原片与原音，不加冷开场配乐。
